subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】breakfast 早餐; English class 英语课; lunch 午餐; music class 音乐课; PE class 体育课; dinner 晚餐; get up 起床; go to school 去上学; go home 回家; go to bed 睡觉
【重点句型】What time is it? 几点了？ It's ... o'clock. ……点钟了。 It's time for ... 该……了。 It's time to ... 该做……了。 Hurry up! 快点！
【A Let's talk】John: What time is it? Wu Yifan: It's 6 o'clock. It's time for dinner. John: Oh! It's 7:30. It's time to go to school. Hurry up!
【Read and write】I get up at 6:30. I have breakfast at 7:00. I go to school at 7:30. I have English class at 9:00. I have lunch at 12:00. I go home at 4:30. I go to bed at 9:00.
key_points: What time is it? 几点了？
